items.title: Ken Poston interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2024
items.q: The mention of Cannonball Adderley occurs solely in the [INTERVIEWER]'s turn ('which I did once with Cannonball Adderley, who is still my guy'). The [INTERVIEWEE] does not mention Adderley in their response or elsewhere in the transcript.

ctx.x: the West Coast things are concerned I would have loved to have been able to hear that group with Gerry and Chet at The Haig for example. I’m sure I could think of dozens more but you know off the top of my head those type things, you know, hearing Dizzy and Bird together in their prime I think would have been for me — now of course I’d love to have heard Bix Beiderbecke, I would love to have heard Louis Armstrong and the Hot 5 session. I would love to have been able to actually witness some of those landmark big…
Yes. And on occasion we get to be in front of our musical heroes, which I did once with Cannonball Adderley, who is still my guy. Addendum, separate insert follows:

Count Basie was coming to Kansas City and because we had played all those Sammy Nestico charts in the high school band, I knew who — Count Basie, I’d read about Count Basie and the connection to Kansas City that I thought for the school newspaper I was going to write a big history of Kansas City jazz and this would be great if I could interview Count Basie then that could be a part of my Kansas City jazz history and it’d be really great in high school to be able to do that. So our principal knew somebody and was…
